description: Grouped currency input combining a decimal amount field, a currency select, and an optional read-only converted-amount field. Conversion is opt-in via the ConvertAsync callback — when null, the converted column is hidden. Supports a manual exchange rate override and full read-only mode. All labels are localizable.

parameters.name: ConvertedAmount
parameters.description: Result of the conversion. Bind this to receive updates from the component.

parameters.name: Currencies
parameters.description: Available currency options shown in the select.

parameters.name: ExchangeRateProvider
parameters.description: Optional exchange-rate provider. When supplied, it takes precedence over ConvertAsync: the component fetches the rate for Currency → TargetCurrency and multiplies the amount by it. If the provider returns null (rate unavailable), the converted value is left unchanged. When null, the existing ConvertAsync callback is used exactly as before.

parameters.name: TargetCurrency
parameters.description: Target currency code the amount is converted into when using ExchangeRateProvider. When null, the selected Currency is used as the target (a self-conversion). Ignored by the callback-based ConvertAsync path, which encodes its own target.

parameters.name: ShowManualRate
parameters.description: Show the manual exchange rate input. Only meaningful when ConvertAsync is provided.

parameters.name: AmountLabel
parameters.description: Override label for the amount field.

parameters.name: CurrencyLabel
parameters.description: Override label for the currency select.

parameters.name: ConvertedLabel
parameters.description: Override label for the converted amount field.

parameters.name: ManualRateLabel
parameters.description: Override label for the manual rate field.

examples.title: With async conversion
examples.code:
<TmCurrencyInput Currencies="@_currencies"
    @bind-Amount="_amount"
    @bind-Currency="_currency"
    @bind-ConvertedAmount="_converted"
    ConvertAsync="ConvertToCzkAsync"
    ConvertedLabel="Amount (CZK)" />

@code {
    private async Task<decimal?> ConvertToCzkAsync(decimal amount, string currency)
    {
        var rate = await _rateService.GetRateAsync(currency, "CZK");
        return rate is null ? null : Math.Round(amount * rate.Value, 2);
    }
}
